unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፱ — Meraf 9: Advanced Mastery of ደ and ጀ

success_screen.headline_en: Brilliant! You solved the advanced ደ and ጀ challenges!
success_screen.headline_am: ድንቅ ነው! የላቁትን የደ እና የጀ ፈተናዎችን በብልሃት ጨረሱ!

games.title: Word Assembly: ጀልባ
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters to build the word for Boat!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 'ጀ', followed by sixth form 'ል', and end with 'ባ'!

games.title: Word Finish: ደብተር
games.instructions_en: Look at the incomplete word for 'Notebook': ደ[ ? ]ተር. Choose the correct missing middle letter!
games.tips_en: The full word is ደብተር (pronounced Deb-ter).

games.title: Audio Blend: ደ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the sound blend. Which symbol represents the exact 'De' sound?

games.title: Word Assembly: ደብተር
games.tips_en: Tip: Start with first form 'ደ', then sixth form 'ብ', then first form 'ተ', and end with 'ር'!

games.title: Word Finish: ጀልባ
games.instructions_en: Find the missing letter to complete the word for 'Boat': ጀል[ ? ].
games.tips_en: The full word is ጀልባ (pronounced Jel-ba).

games.title: Audio Blend: ጀ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely. Which symbol represents the 'Je' sound?

games.title: Word Assembly: ደወል
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 'ደ', followed by 'ወ', and end with sixth form 'ል'!

games.title: Word Finish: ደወል
games.tips_en: The full word is ደወል (pronounced De-we-l).
